title: Pure BT Standard CGM profile data source
symptom: The user asks about a service in the code that implements a pure CGMS profile, but it is not in the data source list on the settings page. They wonder if any other option works with the pure CGM profile, and if not, how to enable it or implement different services on the BLE device.
evidence_quote: As I think you have realized that code is for supporting the bluetooth glucose meter profile. Is there a CGM device which actually supports the standard bluetooth cgm profile?
